scope: Independent source and synthetic fault review only; no production Docker, database, RPC, signing, import, activation, or cleanup action.

findings.title: Old restart occurs before candidate stop is confirmed
findings.trigger: Successful factory-disable CAS through running candidate; candidate stop fails before mutation and inspection still reports Running=true.
findings.observed: recover_runtime records replacement_stop_failed, renames the still-running candidate, and starts the old app. The synthetic model then has both owners running on the retained data volume. Final verification reports unconfirmed only after the unsafe start.
findings.requiredBehavior: Require positive stopped-state inspection of every owned application before renaming/starting the old app. A failed or unavailable inspection leaves old stopped and recovery unconfirmed. Response loss after a successful stop may still recover when stopped state is positively verified.

findings.title: PG helper ownership accepts additional host permissions
findings.trigger: An inspected same-label helper has a HostConfig field absent from the expected request: CapAdd SYS_ADMIN, Devices /dev/mem, or VolumesFrom unrelated:rw.
findings.observed: All three are accepted by assert_pg_only because it compares only keys present in expected HostConfig. Confirmed by independently running QA original adversary against hash-identical helper source.
findings.requiredBehavior: Reject extra host capabilities, devices, inherited volumes and other unsafe namespace/runtime settings before starting or adopting the helper. Account explicitly for actual Docker inspection defaults; preserve foreign occupants.
